LanguageData.CustomFonts.SteamDeckPatch: SteamDeck (Steam Linux Runtime) Host Font Patch (Restart needed)
LanguageData.CustomFonts.Specimen: RimWorld is a sci-fi colony sim driven by an intelligent AI storyteller.
LanguageData.CustomFonts.DebugLoggingDesc: Logs font resource usage and applied settings every 30 seconds. Keep this off during normal play.
LanguageData.CustomFonts.FontPackSearchHelp: Searches the Fonts folders of active mods after Custom Fonts. Counts include selectable font faces and styles. Hover over a mod to see its package ID.
LanguageData.CustomFonts.FontPackSearchEmpty: No active external mods follow Custom Fonts.
LanguageData.CustomFonts.FontSourcesHelp: Add a TTF, OTF or TTC file, or a folder. Relative paths start in this mod folder; environment variables and ~ are supported. TTC uses its first face. Apply search options with Refresh. Selections save family names instead of file paths and prefer regular faces.
LanguageData.CustomFonts.SystemFontDirectoriesHelp: Searched when system fonts are included. Missing directories are skipped.
LanguageData.CustomFonts.EmptyFontPath: Enter a font file or folder path.
LanguageData.CustomFonts.RefreshFontSources: Refresh font list / apply search options
LanguageData.CustomFonts.FontSourceCount: {0} font families, {1} skipped sources (details in log)
LanguageData.CustomFonts.FallbackFontsHelp: Missing characters use these fonts from top to bottom. Applies to UI and world text.
LanguageData.CustomFonts.FallbackTabHelp: Add from the font list with +. Missing characters use this list in order.
LanguageData.CustomFonts.ShowFontNamePreviews: Preview font names in their own font
LanguageData.CustomFonts.ShowFontNamePreviewsHelp: Render visible names at a fixed size and reuse their disk cache. Memory previews are released when this window closes. Default: off.
LanguageData.CustomFonts.PreviewSizeHelp: Applying a different size deletes all font preview caches.
